title: An optimal trace estimate for microlocal square functions on quadratic surfaces
summary: We study a local trace estimate for the microlocal angular square function \[ G_R f := \left(\sum_Θ|f_Θ|^2\right)^{1/2} \] associated with a parabolic decomposition of the frequency annulus of radius $R$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$.
